query: query WindowPullRequests($owner: String!, $name: String!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { list: pullRequests(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: { field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC }) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id number updatedAt } } } rateLimit { remaining resetAt } }
